The 'side nav' row contains a wrapper frame 'Light mode' (4485 wide) that holds its own title card ('Light mode nav bar') and two screens: mapped as a mid-row sub-journey.
Main_nav instances: the Search row uses types=collapsed; every side-nav frame uses types=Expanded. The two Light-mode screens use a separate 'Main_nav light mode' layer.
'contents' is our reading of layer names, not a designer label.

doubts.q: Login: options 1-3 are faded to 30% and option 4 is at full opacity, which reads as 'option 4 chosen'. Your rule is 'option 1 only'. Which login design do we build? Also: the two frames after option 4 show the login form inside a spreadsheet-style app window. Are they login steps (login from an add-in) or a different context?
doubts.proposedDefault: Build option 4, because options 1-3 are faded (parked). Keep the two spreadsheet-window frames as steps 2-3 of the same login journey.

doubts.q: Light mode nav bar appears here (2 screens, inside the side nav row) and also as Chat + Artifacts `nav-light` (4 screens). Which is the source of truth?
doubts.proposedDefault: Chat + Artifacts `nav-light` stays canonical (already confirmed). Use these two screens only as extra references.
